mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) increases risk of QT prolongation and torsades de pointes in patients on methadone, which is also a QT-prolonging agent.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) regularly; maintain electrolyte levels within normal range; consider alternative diuretic or alternative opioid if QT prolongation develops.
